verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.openwebui.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200. It is a curated, machine-readable index of every docs page that an agent can be pointed at directly. Missing for 10: the evidence does not show what other machine-readable entry points exist (e.g. a full-content llms-full.txt or per-page markdown), and there is no independent user corroboration of agents using it.
